stem: Roland would like to add a sentence to the beginning of the fourth paragraph (sentences 11-14) to introduce the ideas in this paragraph. Which of the following would be the BEST sentence to add just before sentence 11?

options.label: F
options.text: A hedgehog is a hard pet to care for.

options.label: G
options.text: Hedgehogs don’t shed, bark, or scratch the furniture.

options.label: H
options.text: The hedgehog will be the perfect companion for you.

options.label: J
options.text: There are many reasons why hedgehogs make great pets.
